meta.title: Companion world console
meta.description: User-authorized world clock, persona, channels and test-session management.

title: Companion world
description: Manage the real world. Administrative actions are user-only.
memoryPrivacy: Private diaries are not injected into external conversations. This page reads only after your click and does not persist content in browser storage. Public diaries start as drafts; publishing never sends a QQ message automatically.
memoryLifecycle: Natural forgetting uses world time to lower recall or archive; pinned items remain. Explicit forgetting clears controlled sources and derivatives and keeps resume blocked until execution-history cleanup completes.
memoryEventTime: Event time (browser timezone; blank means unknown, not the recording time)
memoryPublicAuthorize: Explicitly authorize this material for public use
memoryForgetWarning: Confirmation erases selected memories, related sources and derivatives, and resets affected execution context. QQ platform history and external exports cannot be retracted. This cannot be undone.
memoryPauseRequired: Pause the world before irreversible forgetting.
memoryCleanupPending: Core content erased; execution-history cleanup is pending. Stay paused until it completes. This is not a claim that every copy was erased.
memoryCleanupComplete: No controlled cleanup remains pending. External platform copies are outside this service’s erasure scope.
authHint: Obtain the operator token using the VM terminal helper. It stays in this browser tab’s session storage and is sent only to loopback port 3082; never paste it in chat.
error: Request failed. No current world data is being shown.
snapshot: Values are from the last successful API read. Refresh to update.
pauseHint: Pausing freezes world time and stops proposal processing. Resuming does not catch up the stopped duration. Persona edits remain explicit operator actions.
name: Name
arrayHint: Traits, boundaries and principles: one entry per line.
conflictHint: On revision conflict, refresh and reapply your changes; changes are never retried silently.

personaPanel.neutralHint: The user call name and relationship stage are saved but not used in conversation context yet: everyone shares one persona, so one person's nickname never reaches someone else.
personaPanel.previewHint: Rendered on the server from the current (unsaved) editor content, exactly like the persona block in conversation context. Previewing never saves.
personaPanel.previewCount: Characters / persona share when memories exist
personaPanel.previewTruncated: Over the persona share: with memories present it is truncated and the tail (usually the dialogue examples) is lost.
personaPanel.importHint: Export saves the current editor content. Import only loads the editor; review it and click Save persona to apply. Fields missing from the file take the default persona's values.
personaPanel.imported: Loaded into the editor; not saved yet.
personaPanel.invalidFile: Invalid persona file: only persona fields are allowed, and each example needs user and assistant.
personaPanel.defaultLoaded: Default persona loaded into the editor; not saved yet.

noChannels: No channels returned by the API.
qqHint: QQ is not connected. No QQ login, ingress or model conversation has been accepted.
runtimeHint: The browser talks directly to the operator API on loopback port 3082. The operator token is never sent to the conversation executor or model tools.
strategyHint: All channels share the same Authority conversation port. Each source/conversation must have an operator-created binding. QQ needs its own message entry configuration.
not_verified: Not verified — chat capability has not been accepted.
setupHint: The gateway chooses the configured model. This console does not deploy services. Configuration and test results are not written into core memory.
modelHint: Official DeepSeek endpoint only. Allowed models: deepseek-flash (default), deepseek-v4-pro. Saving is not verification.
modelPauseRequired: Pause the world before changing the model.
modelKeyKeep: Leave the API key empty to keep the saved key. Saved keys are never displayed, including their suffix.
modelKeyRequired: No API key is configured. Enter a key to configure the model; there is no enable switch.
modelKeyPrivacy: The API key is sent only in POST /model to loopback port 3082. It is never stored in this tab’s sessionStorage, URL, conversation executor or model prompt. The field clears immediately after a successful save.
modelTestHint: Explicitly sends a small request using the saved model and key; this may incur charges. Save edits first. No automatic test or conversation is started.
modelTestFailed: Model test failed. Check the saved configuration and retry explicitly.

modelStatus.unconfigured: Not configured — no API key saved.
modelStatus.verified: Verified by an explicit model test; this is not conversation acceptance.
modelStatus.error: Configured — the last model test failed.

qqPrivateHint: Only your own private messages are accepted. Groups are not enabled; no enable switch or automatic binding is provided.
qqStatusPending: QQ status has not been read. Refresh or enter this tab to load it.
qqNotConfigured: QQ access is not fully configured.
qqCallerConfigured: Your sender binding is saved; the QQ number is never displayed.
qqCallerMissing: Your sender binding has not been saved.
qqPaused: Maintenance pause: new replies and core-state effects remain paused.
qqRunning: The world is running. Pause it before changing your sender binding.
qqLoginHint: First ask the trusted maintenance helper to open the official NapCat WebUI and complete QR login. This card does not display a QR code or manage login credentials.
qqPauseRequired: Pause the world before saving QQ access.
qqCallerHint: Enter the QQ number you use to send messages to the bot—not the QQ account logged into the bot. Saving explicitly binds this sender to person:owner, for private messages only.
qqCallerPrivacy: Digits only. Sent only in POST /qq to the operator API; never stored in sessionStorage, URLs, logs or conversation executor. The field clears after a successful save and never echoes a saved number.
standaloneDescription: Independent Companion world console · directly manages the same real Authority.
standaloneRuntimeHint: Static assets and operator API share this loopback origin. Closing the page does not stop services. Conversations run in the separate companion-conversation executor (pi-agent-core), which never receives the operator token.
standaloneSetupHint: Changes use the controlled operator API. This page does not install plugins, reset persona or resume the world automatically. Model settings, voice references and world memories are separate.

speechPanel.title: Local speech and defaults

unavailable.not_configured: Speech is not configured: there is no speech.json on the server. Run ops/prepare-speech.mjs on the host to create it.
unavailable.config_schema_outdated: The speech config uses the old format (schema 1), which is no longer read. On the host, move operator/speech.json and speech-models.json aside, then re-run ops/prepare-speech.mjs.
unavailable.config_invalid: The speech config cannot be read or is invalid. Check operator/speech.json on the host; other settings are unaffected.

speechPanel.localHint: Recognition and synthesis use local file engines, without a microphone, speaker or GPU requirement. Saving parameters is not human voice acceptance.
speechPanel.pending: Runtime state has not been read. Refresh to load the real API result.
speechPanel.benchmarkHint: A CPU benchmark does not certify naturalness, long-form reliability or realtime streaming. Names and states come from the server.
speechPanel.pauseRequired: Pause the world before changing speech parameters, voices or generating an audition.
speechPanel.noVoices: No voice is registered; explicit voice requests fall back to text.
speechPanel.noDefault: No default voice. Choose one with “Make default”.
speechPanel.voiceHint: Each voice is registered from an operator-uploaded reference recording. The model can only pick a voice ID, never a file path. A reference affects vocal expression, not persona, and is never extracted from QQ audio. Usage scope is a recorded label: internal voices (e.g. a real person's recording) may be used in family/friends private and group chats but must not be published.
speechPanel.conditioningHint: The CPU runner conditions only on the speaker audio. The transcript records provenance and is not used for synthesis, including cross-lingual references (e.g. Japanese reference, Chinese output). Exact reproduction is not guaranteed; a fixed test sentence is not voice-quality certification.
speechPanel.cleanupPending: The voice was removed, but its reference files are not fully cleared. Retry cleanup before registering another voice; removal does not prove complete erasure.
speechPanel.removeSubmitted: Removal handled. Check the refreshed voices and cleanup status.
speechPanel.removeWarning: Remove only this voice and the audio/transcript registered through this page. If it is the default, no default remains. This does not erase other media, QQ history, persona memories or model weights.
speechPanel.audioFile: Reference: mono PCM16 WAV, 3–20 seconds, at most 2 MiB
speechPanel.authorized: I have the right to use this recording and authorize retaining its audio and transcript locally as a voice-synthesis reference.
speechPanel.referenceSaved: Voice registered; persona and world pause were not changed.
speechPanel.testHint: Auditions use a fixed public sentence and local synthesis only. No cloud, QQ send or world resume. Play manually when ready; generation may take tens of seconds.
speechPanel.testReady: Audition ready. Play manually; this is not voice-quality certification.
speechPanel.imageUnavailable: No image-generation engine is configured. Understanding or sending images is not image generation; no fictional enable control is provided.

errors.invalid_voice_fields: Enter a voice ID (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; max 40), a display name (max 64), a 2–3 letter lowercase language code, and choose a usage scope.
errors.invalid_speech_parameters: Check 1–16 threads and the 1–120 character limit.
errors.invalid_reference_audio: Choose a mono PCM16 WAV, 3–20 seconds and at most 2 MiB; renaming an extension does not convert audio.
errors.reference_authorization_required: Explicit recording rights and local long-term reference consent are required.
errors.authorization_required: Authorization is missing, expired or rejected. Enter the operator token again.
errors.loopback_required: Open the product through an HTTP loopback address (localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1). Remote or HTTPS pages cannot use this operator endpoint.
errors.invalid_response: The API returned an invalid response. Check the service version and refresh.
errors.request_failed: The operation failed. Check the operator service and retry explicitly.
errors.revision_conflict: The revision changed. Refresh the world and reapply your changes.
errors.network: Cannot reach the operator API. Check port 3082, CORS and service availability.
errors.invalid_qq_uid: Enter your sending QQ number using digits only.
errors.validation_error: The input does not meet the field requirements. Check it and retry.
errors.invalid_request: The request was malformed. Refresh the page and retry.
errors.body_too_large: The submitted content is too large. Reduce it and retry.
errors.operation_failed: The server operation failed. Check the service logs and retry explicitly.
